load_scales_from_json_or_pt: load scale factors from a JSON or PyTorch .pt file into a PyTorch nn.Module's ScaleFactor submodules
load_scales_from_dict: load scale factors from a Python dictionary mapping scale factor names to float or tensor values
load_scale_dict_internal: parse a scale factor file path or dictionary into a normalized dictionary of scale factor names to values
review_load_scales_compat: review the load_scales_compat function to verify it correctly maps scale factor names to ScaleFactor submodules
refactor_load_scale_dict: refactor the _load_scale_dict function to support additional file formats like YAML for scale factor definitions
